decisions.reason: As a close-to-core formwork product line that supports the firm's integrated prefabrication offering and has already survived the early launch phase, it is likely to be retained.
This automation-related control product fits the firm's strategic push toward higher automation and efficiency, so management would generally continue it unless demand proves persistently weak.
The magnetic formwork strips line remains well aligned with the firm's modular formwork business and is more likely to stay as part of the established portfolio than be withdrawn.
Although magnetic accessories can be rationalized more easily than core systems, this component still fits the firm's tailored prefabrication offer and is more likely to be kept than dropped.
